audit_rule: Binary strict credit: a high-impact preference counts only when a model-visible question targeted that trade-off and the user's answer resolved it. Volunteered information in an answer to an unrelated field is not credited.
unit_rule: Each form field is one atomic question for burden accounting, even when its label or options bundle multiple outcomes.

cold_start_no_ask_rule: Eligible instruction-only no-ask runs have zero clarification turns, questions, precision denominator, and Coverage@HighImpact by construction.
full_persona_rule: Full-persona/no-ask is excluded from the Coverage@HighImpact association because the preferences are supplied in the initial context rather than recovered through clarification.
